en: Ancient builders used inclined planes over 1.6 kilometers long to move massive stone blocks up the Great Pyramid of Giza.
Rubber tires grip dry asphalt about 10 times better than they grip wet ice due to significantly higher friction.
Gravity on the Moon is about one-sixth as strong as Earth's gravity, making a 60-kilogram person weigh only 10 kilograms there.
The strongest permanent neodymium magnets can lift up to 1,000 times their own weight in heavy iron objects.
A single lightning bolt can heat the air to 30,000 degrees Celsius, making it five times hotter than the Sun's surface.
Light travels at 300,000 kilometers per second, taking exactly 8 minutes and 20 seconds to reach Earth from the Sun.
Sound travels about 4.3 times faster in water than in air, moving at 1,480 meters per second underwater.
Water needs about five times more heat energy to warm up by one degree compared to the same amount of dry sand.
A standard AA alkaline battery stores about 10,800 joules of chemical energy, enough to power a small LED flashlight for 20 hours.
A standard wood screw has a mechanical advantage of about 20, multiplying your turning force by 20 times to enter the wood.
One gram of fat stores 9 Calories of chemical energy, which is more than double the 4 Calories in one gram of carbohydrates.
Maglev trains use magnetic repulsion to float 10 millimeters above the track, eliminating wheel friction and reaching speeds over 600 kilometers per hour.
